selection: First 1000 valid listings in source order with at least two nonempty reviews; first 20 distinct review IDs per listing in source order.
transformations: Joined listing id with review listing_id and embedded review records under each listing.
Removed blank comments and duplicate review IDs; capped imported reviews at 20 per listing.
Converted source USD price strings to integer cents and validated ISO dates.
Retained source reviewer IDs separately from future application account IDs.
Did not import names of hosts/reviewers, exact addresses, image assets, or calendar data.
Source review records have written comments and dates but no individual star-rating field.
Dataset is a historical snapshot; the project does not claim current availability or live booking.
applicationNotes: Historic research snapshot only. Prices and reviews do not describe current availability.
Reviewer IDs are removed from the application. Free text can still contain personal information.
No source property photos, exact addresses, calendars or individual review star ratings are imported.
Reference catalogue and historic reviews are read-only. New shared media has independent full CRUD.
